title: Book Cover Design Brief - Whispers of the Past
content: The book cover for 'Whispers of the Past' should evoke a sense of mystery and nostalgia. The main elements to include are an old, ornate key and a faded letter. The color scheme should be muted earth tones. Please refer to the attached synopsis and author bio for more context on the themes of the story.

title: Personal Notes on 'Whispers of the Past'
content: While the plot of 'Whispers of the Past' is somewhat clichéd with predictable twists, and the characters lack depth, the setting descriptions are vivid and could be visually compelling for the cover design.
